scope: Corollary 9.3 (Flat scalar principal values) of the manuscript “Annular variation of the triangular Hilbert transform at the symmetric point” (preprints/Annular-variation-of-the-triangular-Hilbert-transform-at-the-symmetric-point-October-5-2026/annular-variation.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 082 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f5857c58037fa528), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every complex L3 triple, each finite flat truncation is absolutely integrable, and sup 0<ε<R<∞ |Lε,R(F0, F1, F2)| ≤ CM 2 ∏︂ v=0 ∥Fv∥3. Its joint scalar principal value exists and equals ∫︁ R2 F0B(F1, F2). This limiting form is the unique bounded complex trilinear extension of its compactly supported smooth definition.
